title: The Unexpected Prom
author: Coral Joubert
blurb: Casper Ravensworth, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
